{{Quote|The secret to our mouthwatering nerfsteak is the seasoning:	a unique blend of Serrian salt, tertium, punctil and black hole pepper that's been handed down in my family for generations.|Dex's Diner menu, on the nerfsteak and eggs|<ref name="Dining at Dex's" />}}
'''Punctil''' was a type of [[Foodstuff/Legends|additive]] used to season food. The [[Besalisk/Legends|Besalisk]] [[Chef/Legends|chef]] [[Dexter Jettster/Legends|Dexter Jettster]] used it along with [[Serrian salt]], [[tertium]]. and [[black hole pepper]] to created the [[Dexter Jettster's nerfsteak seasoning|seasoning]] for the [[Nerf steak/Legends|nerfsteaks]] that he sold at his [[Restaurant/Legends|restaurant]], [[Dex's Diner/Legends|Dex's Diner]],<ref name="Dining at Dex's" /> on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]]<ref name="Atlas">''[[The Essential Atlas]]''</ref> [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]].<ref name="Dining at Dex's" />

==Behind the scenes==
Punctil was mentioned in "[[Dining at Dex's]]," a [[Hyperspace: The Official Star Wars Fan Club|Hyperspace]]-exclusive written by [[Gregory Walker]] as an [[in-universe]] menu for Dex's Diner. "Dining at Dex's" was published to Hyperspace on [[December 3]], [[2009]].<ref name="Dining at Dex's" /> Punctil was originally included in a draft of the script for the  [[1978]] ''[[The Star Wars Holiday Special]]'' but was not included in the final release.<ref name="Holiday Special">''[[The Star Wars Holiday Special]]''</ref>
